title: Gets density and mean circulation right; misses correlated detector noise
finding: GPT-6 Luna High changed only fit(). The first tilted-generator coefficient stayed diagonal, omitting mixed longitudinal/detector diffusion. Twenty-one of 23 hidden groups were already below tolerance; anisotropic noise and the third cumulant were wrong.

actions.action: Connects fit() to the supplied fit_friction helper.

diagnosis: Physical noise-correlation omission. Noise error was 27.58% and third-cumulant error 101.10%. Restoring the mixed diffusion term gives 0.0316% and 0.0614%, respectively, with no refit.
confidence: Confirmed by a targeted diagnostic intervention
